created_for: Metabolic-gene-only analysis of cancer single-cell RNA-seq

papers.title: Hallmarks of transcriptional intratumour heterogeneity across a thousand tumours
papers.rationale: The 3CA source study provides the pan-cancer program-discovery design, frozen 2023 data snapshot, and recurrent metabolic-related transcriptional programs needed for the first benchmark family.
papers.candidate_claim: Across 1,163 tumour samples from 24 tumour types, malignant-cell NMF programs collapsed into 41 recurrent meta-programs and 11 hallmarks, including metabolism-related programs.

papers.title: Metabolic landscape of the tumor microenvironment at single cell resolution
papers.rationale: This is the closest published precedent to clustering cells using metabolic-gene expression and testing whether metabolic profiles distinguish malignant, immune, and stromal compartments.
papers.candidate_claim: Metabolic-gene expression separates cell populations in melanoma and HNSCC; mitochondrial programs are a major source of heterogeneity and immune/stromal cells can be distinguished by metabolic features.

papers.title: Pan-cancer T cell atlas links a cellular stress response state to immunotherapy resistance
papers.rationale: A large, multi-cancer T-cell reference with explicit CD8 subsets and sample-level clinical metadata is suitable for within-cell-type state discovery and cross-cohort validation.
papers.candidate_claim: A recurrent stress-response T-cell state occurs across cancers and is distinct from other CD4 and CD8 states; it is enriched after checkpoint blockade particularly in nonresponding tumours.

papers.title: Pan-cancer single-cell landscape of tumor-infiltrating T cells
papers.rationale: The study supplies a large pan-cancer T-cell atlas and processed public data for testing whether metabolic states recur within CD8 cells across cancer types.
papers.candidate_claim: Tumour-infiltrating T cells occupy recurrent transcriptional states across cancer types, including distinct CD8 populations and candidate tumour-reactive states.

papers.title: Landscape of Infiltrating T Cells in Liver Cancer Revealed by Single-Cell Sequencing
papers.rationale: A foundational patient-resolved tumour T-cell dataset with CD8 subpopulations and paired TCR information, useful for within-CD8 metabolic-state tests.
papers.candidate_claim: Infiltrating T cells in liver cancer contain multiple recurrent functional states, including distinct exhausted and effector CD8 populations.

papers.title: A transcriptionally and functionally distinct PD-1+ CD8+ T cell pool with predictive potential in non-small-cell lung cancer treated with PD-1 blockade
papers.rationale: The paper anchors the distinction between activation, dysfunction, and tumour-reactivity within CD8 T cells and provides orthogonal functional measurements.
papers.candidate_claim: PD-1-high CD8 T cells in NSCLC form a transcriptionally and functionally distinct population associated with response to PD-1 blockade.

papers.title: A Cancer Cell Program Promotes T Cell Exclusion and Resistance to Checkpoint Blockade
papers.rationale: Provides a patient-level test of whether a malignant-cell transcriptional state is associated with an immune-cell phenotype and clinical response, useful as an association-control task.
papers.candidate_claim: A malignant-cell resistance program is associated with T-cell exclusion and predicts anti-PD-1 response in an independent cohort.

papers.title: A functional single-cell metabolic survey identifies Elovl1 as a target to enhance CD8+ T cell fitness in solid tumours
papers.rationale: The strongest recent perturbational study directly linking metabolic genes, single-cell transcriptional states, and CD8 T-cell function in solid tumours.
papers.candidate_claim: An in vivo metabolic CRISPR survey coupled to scRNA-seq identified metabolic perturbations that shift CD8 states, with Elovl1 loss supporting effector and memory phenotypes and anti-PD-1 response.

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Immune Landscape of Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastasis at Single-Cell Level
papers.rationale: This paper introduced the scMetabolism package in a tumour atlas and directly compared metabolic activities across immune-cell states and anatomical sites.
papers.candidate_claim: MRC1+ CCL18+ macrophages in colorectal liver metastases show a highly active metabolic transcriptional profile, especially in metastatic tumours.

papers.title: A pan-cancer blueprint of the heterogeneous tumor microenvironment revealed by single-cell profiling
papers.rationale: A large cross-cancer reference of stromal and immune phenotypes, suitable for testing cell-type association and patient-versus-cell-type confounding.
papers.candidate_claim: Across lung, colorectal, ovarian, and breast tumours, stromal and immune cells form both shared and tissue-specific phenotypes, including distinct CD8 trajectories.

papers.title: Single-cell CRISPR screens in vivo map T cell fate regulomes in cancer
papers.rationale: Perturb-seq-style evidence enables more stringent evaluation of whether inferred CD8 states respond coherently to causal regulators rather than reflecting cluster labels alone.
papers.candidate_claim: In vivo single-cell CRISPR screening resolves regulators of multiple intratumoural CD8 T-cell fates, including metabolic activation versus quiescence programs.

papers.title: pH sensing controls tissue inflammation by modulating cellular metabolism and endo-lysosomal function of immune cells
papers.rationale: Uses Compass together with metabolomic and functional measurements, providing a guardrail against equating transcript-derived metabolic scores with measured flux.
papers.candidate_claim: Perturbed pH sensing shifts immune-cell metabolic programs and inflammatory function, with Compass predictions supported by orthogonal assays.

papers.title: Metabolic modeling of single Th17 cells reveals regulators of autoimmunity
papers.rationale: Compass is a central single-cell constraint-based metabolic method with perturbational validation and explicit metabolic-state clustering.
papers.candidate_claim: Compass separates pathogenic and non-pathogenic Th17 metabolic states and identifies a glycolysis-versus-fatty-acid-oxidation switch plus polyamine metabolism as a regulator.

papers.title: A graph neural network model to estimate cell-wise metabolic flux using single-cell RNA-seq data
papers.rationale: scFEA directly produces cell-wise module flux scores and includes downstream clustering of cells with distinct metabolic states plus matched metabolomic validation.
papers.candidate_claim: scFEA estimates relative cell-wise metabolic module fluxes that recover condition- and cell-group-specific metabolic variation and agree directionally with matched metabolomics.

papers.title: Characterizing cancer metabolism from bulk and single-cell RNA-seq data using METAFlux
papers.rationale: METAFlux is cancer-focused, models metabolic activity at cell-cluster/community resolution, and benchmarks predictions against measured metabolite flux.
papers.candidate_claim: METAFlux recovers cancer metabolic heterogeneity and cell-type interactions; its outputs are relative inferred fluxes and are computed for groups rather than literal single-cell measured flux.

papers.title: Building and mining a network of single cell metabolic models
papers.rationale: scFBA is an early reference for constructing cell-specific metabolic models and comparing metabolic states while enforcing a network model.
papers.candidate_claim: Single-cell transcriptomes can constrain a network of cell-specific metabolic models that exposes heterogeneous metabolic capabilities and intercellular relationships.

papers.title: Met-Flow, a strategy for single-cell metabolic analysis highlights dynamic changes in immune subpopulations
papers.rationale: Met-Flow measures metabolic proteins at single-cell resolution and is retained as an orthogonal comparator, not as an scRNA-seq leaderboard task.
papers.candidate_claim: A targeted panel of metabolic proteins distinguishes immune-cell subsets and detects dynamic metabolic remodeling, but represents metabolic capacity rather than direct flux.

papers.title: MEBOCOST maps metabolite-mediated intercellular communications using single-cell RNA-seq
papers.rationale: Extends cell-type metabolic states to metabolite-mediated communication and includes simulation, spatial, CRISPR, and clinical validation.
papers.candidate_claim: MEBOCOST infers candidate metabolite-mediated sender-receiver relationships from enzyme, sensor, and optional flux information; the result is an association requiring orthogonal validation.

papers.title: Functional interpretation of single cell similarity maps
papers.rationale: VISION is the default engine used by scMetabolism and directly annotates variation over a cell-cell similarity graph.
papers.candidate_claim: VISION detects and scores biological signatures over single-cell similarity maps without requiring predefined clusters.

papers.title: UCell: Robust and scalable single-cell gene signature scoring
papers.rationale: UCell offers composition-robust, rank-based per-cell scoring and is a strong baseline for the fixed 1,988-gene list.
papers.candidate_claim: UCell scores depend on within-cell gene ranks and are robust to dataset size and composition while scaling to large single-cell datasets.

papers.title: UCell and pyUCell: single-cell gene signature scoring for R and Python
papers.rationale: The current cross-language implementation supplies AnnData support, explicit missing-gene handling, signed signatures, and optional score smoothing.
papers.candidate_claim: UCell v2 and pyUCell provide reproducible rank-based signature scoring across R and Python with controlled handling of missing genes and optional kNN score smoothing.

papers.title: GSVA: gene set variation analysis for microarray and RNA-seq data
papers.rationale: GSVA/ssGSEA-style scoring remains a widely used magnitude-aware baseline and is necessary for method-family sensitivity comparisons.
papers.candidate_claim: GSVA transforms gene-level expression into sample-wise pathway scores in an unsupervised manner; application to sparse single-cell data requires explicit benchmarking rather than assumption of equivalence.

papers.title: decoupleR: ensemble of computational methods to infer biological activities from omics data
papers.rationale: Provides a common interface and consensus framework for comparing several enrichment/statistical methods under one data contract.
papers.candidate_claim: Method consensus can improve robustness of inferred activities, but performance depends jointly on the scoring statistic and prior-knowledge resource.

papers.title: Benchmarking algorithms for pathway activity transformation of single-cell RNA-seq data
papers.rationale: Directly evaluates whether pathway-transformed representations preserve cell-type structure and support clustering across 32 datasets.
papers.candidate_claim: Pathway activity transformations can retain cell-type heterogeneity, but accuracy, dropout stability, and scalability differ substantially among methods and dataset technologies.

papers.title: Robustness and applicability of transcription factor and pathway analysis tools on single-cell RNA-seq data
papers.rationale: Uses perturbation-based ground truth to separate the value of gene-set resources from the scoring algorithms applied to single-cell data.
papers.candidate_claim: Pathway and regulator activities can preserve biologically meaningful single-cell variation, and performance is often more sensitive to the prior-knowledge resource than to the enrichment statistic.

papers.title: Inferring pathway activity from single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data with PaaSc
papers.rationale: A recent peer-reviewed pathway-activity method benchmarked on multimodal and cancer datasets with versioned Zenodo source data and code.
papers.candidate_claim: PaaSc infers pathway activity in a joint cell-gene latent space and reports robustness to batch effects across single-cell, spatial, and multimodal benchmarks.

papers.title: Benchmarking atlas-level data integration in single-cell genomics
papers.rationale: Defines biology-conservation and batch-removal metrics needed to prevent metabolic clusters from merely rediscovering study, donor, chemistry, or tumour batch.
papers.candidate_claim: Single-cell integration methods trade off batch removal and biological conservation; no method dominates all tasks and datasets.

papers.title: Confronting false discoveries in single-cell differential expression
papers.rationale: Establishes the hard requirement to model biological replicates rather than treating cells as independent observations in state comparisons.
papers.candidate_claim: Methods that ignore between-replicate variation can report large numbers of false differential-expression findings when no biological difference exists.

papers.title: A practical solution to pseudoreplication bias in single-cell studies
papers.rationale: Supplies a focused benchmark for false precision caused by cell-level pseudoreplication and supports donor-aware mixed or aggregated analyses.
papers.candidate_claim: Treating cells as independent replicates inflates significance; donor-aware hierarchical analysis controls pseudoreplication bias.

papers.title: The current landscape and emerging challenges of benchmarking single-cell methods
papers.rationale: A current systematic audit of 282 single-cell benchmarking papers; retained to govern extensibility, interoperability, dataset choice, robustness, and downstream evaluation.
papers.candidate_claim: Reliable single-cell benchmarks require explicit attention to dataset roles, robustness, downstream evaluation, reproducibility, extensibility, and interoperability.
